description: Add Super Admin Full Control panel - super admin can view/modify users, clubs, events, registrations. Add handlers for managing all data.
steps: STEP 1 - Expand super admin panel in bot/handlers/admin.py: Update super_admin_panel() to show more commands. Add new commands: /users (list users with pagination), /clubs (list all clubs), /events_all (list all events), /edit_user (edit user data), /edit_event (edit event), /delete_event (delete/cancel event), /user_info <tg_id> (show user details).

STEP 2 - Add CRUD functions in bot/database/crud.py: (a) get_all_users(limit, offset) - paginated user list. (b) get_all_events(limit, offset) - all events regardless of status. (c) update_event(event_id, **kwargs) - update event fields. (d) cancel_event(event_id) - set event status to CANCELLED. (e) update_user_club(telegram_id, club_id) - change user's club. (f) update_user_points(telegram_id, points) - set user points and recalculate status. (g) get_club_by_id(club_id) - get single club. (h) delete_club(club_id) - delete a club.

STEP 3 - Add super admin handler implementations in bot/handlers/admin.py: (a) /users command - shows paginated list of users (first 20) with inline buttons for next page. (b) /user_info <tg_id> - shows full user details (name, club, role, points, status, registrations count). (c) /edit_user FSM - asks for telegram_id, then shows options (change role, change club, change points). (d) /edit_event FSM - asks for event_id, then allows changing title, description, status, points. (e) /delete_event <id> - cancels an event. (f) /clubs - lists all clubs with member counts.

STEP 4 - Add keyboards for super admin: In bot/keyboards/menus.py add: (a) super_admin_menu_keyboard() - inline keyboard with all management options. (b) user_management_keyboard(user_id) - inline buttons for edit/promote. (c) event_management_keyboard(event_id) - inline buttons for edit/cancel/delete.
STEP 5 - Update main menu: In bot/keyboards/menus.py main_menu_keyboard(): For SUPER_ADMIN role, also add a button for '📊 Statistika' that shows counts of users, events, clubs.
acceptance_criteria: Super admin can list all users with /users command
Super admin can view user details with /user_info
Super admin can edit events (title, status, points)
Super admin can change user's club assignment
Super admin can change user's points
Super admin can list all clubs
All new handlers are restricted to SUPER_ADMIN role only
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/bott/UFQ_EVENT_BOT_FINAL && python -m py_compile bot/handlers/admin.py && echo OK
Run: python -m py_compile bot/database/crud.py && echo OK
Run: python -m py_compile bot/keyboards/menus.py && echo OK
Run: python -c "from bot.handlers.admin import admin_router; from bot.database.crud import get_all_users, get_all_events, update_event, cancel_event; print('All imports OK')"
findings: All CRUD functions, admin handlers, and keyboards implemented successfully. All py_compile and import checks pass. The clubs handler uses get_all_clubs which relies on the relationship loading (club.users) - this works because the data is loaded within the session context. The promote_user function does not support promoting to SUPER_ADMIN by design.
